description: FMRI studies on emotional processing often make use of visual, emotional face or scene stimuli (Sabatinelli et al., 2011). description: The default mode network (Gusnard and Raichle, 2001 -> check REF) is closely linked to socio-affective processing (Schilbach et al., 2012 -> check REF). Therefore, Amft et al. This network consists of the anterior cingulate cortex, bilateral amygdala and hippocampus, temporo-parietal junction, ventral basal ganglia, precuneus, subgenual cingulate cortex, ventromedial and dorsomedial prefrontal cortex and left middle temporal gyrus and sulcus (Amft et al., 2015).
